verdict.line: You lose this if you let the game drag while Shen teleports around the map; you win it by using your range to dominate the lane and solo-kill him before that matters.

brief.thesis: Gnar's Q (Boomerang Throw, range 1100) outranges every tool Shen has — Vorpal Blade is 475 range and Shadow Dash is 575 — so mini Gnar can poke freely as long as he respects the dash timer. Shen's only defensive tool is Feint, a self-shield with no displacement, so once it's down he is fully exposed to burst. The 47.6% head-to-head despite a measured lane and solo-kill advantage for you means the danger isn't the 1v1, it's Shen's Stand United letting him vanish to swing other lanes while this one looks close on paper.

theirWindow.what: Once Shen has E, any dash through you taunts and lets him chain Vorpal Blade autos with Ki Strike behind it. Stay off cooldown-threat range (575) near the wave until you've tracked his E timer.

yourWindow.what: Feint only absorbs damage for a few seconds and resets on a 9-5s cooldown by rank. Dump Q (Boomerang Throw) plus your Hyper (W) empowered third auto the moment it's down — that's the OP.GG read and it's correct.

start.why: The 66.9% pick rate option at 48.6% win in this matchup — you need the sustain and trade damage to keep poking through Vorpal Blade's life-tap healing.

boots.why: Shen's damage is mostly autos (Ki Strike, Vorpal Blade) — Plated Steelcaps is the higher-pick option (59.5%) for cutting that down.

core.why: The best-measured path (54.2% over 24 games) into Black Cleaver into Sterak's Gage; Trinity's proc stacks with your Hyper (W) empowered auto for the trades this matchup rewards.
Shred his armor to make your Boulder Toss and Crunch hit harder once you're committing to Mega Gnar trades.
Survivability for forced all-ins once Feint is down and you're fully committed into his taunt range.

situational.when: shen builds toward a tankier, longer-trade style and you need to blunt his sustained dueling
you want more attack speed to proc Hyper (W) and Ki Strike trades faster
vorpal blade's life-tap healing is keeping him in fights longer than it should

runes.keystoneWhy: The higher-pick page (25.3% pick, 53.8% win) — the heal and move speed on hit fit a kite-and-poke plan against a melee champion whose only real threat is a taunt dash. Master-tier Gnar players instead favor Lethal Tempo across 1,803 games; that suits players who plan to sit in auto range and stack attack speed rather than disengage after every trade.

summoners.why: Teleport is the standard pick (79.2% pick rate) and matters more here than usual since Shen can Stand United away — you need to be able to answer his map pressure. Flash + Ignite measures higher (52.6% win) if you'd rather lean on your solo-kill advantage and end the lane early instead.

playing.title: Poke at max Q range pre-6
playing.detail: Throw Boomerang before Shen has Shadow Dash (levels 1-2) and keep doing it after — at 1100 range he has no answer until E is up.

playing.title: Track his E cooldown, not just his position
playing.detail: Shadow Dash is 16/14/12/10/8s by rank. Once he has it, don't stand in a spot where a dash through you sets up a taunt-locked trade.

playing.title: Trade the instant Feint goes down
playing.detail: Feint only lasts a few seconds and is 9-5s on cooldown by rank — commit Q plus your empowered third auto right after he's used it, not before.

playing.title: Use Hop to escape, not just engage
playing.detail: Hop bounces you off a unit's head and travels further — use it to clear the wave and get out before a dash lands, especially once he has E.

playing.title: Save all-ins for Mega Gnar windows
playing.detail: Once Rage maxes, Wallop's stun plus Crunch's area damage outlasts a single Feint shield — that's your best forced-trade tool, not your mini-form poke.

playing.title: Don't assume a lane lead is the whole game
playing.detail: Stand United (200/180/160/160/160s cooldown) lets him shield and teleport to save or swing another lane — push for plates and objectives before he has it up repeatedly.

playing.title: Respect his Q life-tap in extended fights
playing.detail: Vorpal Blade heals allies who attack the target he's hit — don't let a long, low-intensity trade go on forever or his sustain outlasts yours.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, summoner, and win-rate numbers are measured from current-patch OP.GG games; the mechanical reasoning and trade timing above are this brief's own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Use [Q] and your third basic attack to lane easily. Avoid being hit with (E) as he can easily regain control over lane.
